versions.subject: feat: multiple updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_wscript_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\wscript.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wscript.exe'
selection_wscript_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: 'manage-bde.wsf'
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'manage-bde.wsf'
filter_cmd:
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
condition: all of selection_wscript_* or (selection_parent and not filter_cmd)
versions.spl: (Image="*\\wscript.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wscript.exe" CommandLine="*manage-bde.wsf*") OR (ParentImage IN ("*\\cscript.exe", "*\\wscript.exe") ParentCommandLine="*manage-bde.wsf*" NOT Image="*\\cmd.exe")
